title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-11

ai_review.summary: A scorching, holy‑grail performance captured in a solid recording that lets the percolating intensity shine from start to finish.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about an unrelenting, jam‑heavy show that they compare to the fire of June ’68, calling it the “holy grail” of Dead concerts. The recording is praised for its vibe and lack of noticeable flaws, while the live energy—especially Pigpen’s vocals and Garcia’s dueling guitar work—is described as unforgettable.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 5‑star, uniformly enthusiastic about both performance and overall sound; no negative comments were noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific technical complaints; reviewers emphasize the recording captures the show’s energy well.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as nonstop and percolating, with a relentless intensity that never lets up throughout the concert.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia highlighted for his intense dueling guitar work alongside Dwayne and Peter Green.
